facts.fact: Decree n°06-442/P-RM of 18 October 2006 is made to apply Law n°06-040 of 11 August 2006 instituting the national identification number NINA for persons and legal entities, which it cites as in force.
facts.system: Loi n°06-040 du 11 août 2006 portant institution du Numéro d'Identification Nationale (NINA)

facts.fact: Decree n°06-442/P-RM of 18 October 2006 fixes how Law n°06-040 applies: the structure of the 14-digit NINA, the data held, how it is attributed, transmission of civil-status data, and an obligation on named public services, embassies and consulates to use the NINA and show it on their documents.
facts.system: Loi n°06-040 du 11 août 2006 portant institution du Numéro d'Identification Nationale (NINA)
